question: What rejuvenating effect does six months of practice produce in an aged practitioner?
premises: The practice is performed for six months
It is done through repeated application
Even an old person becomes youthful
inference: Six months of repeated practice can make even an aged person become youthful.
uncertainties: taruṇā form may be irregular; āyate may derive from √yā or √i
plain_english: Through six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
